name: cofail-substrate
description: Model-by-item binary correctness matrices for 1,228-1,373 open language models per benchmark across five Open LLM Leaderboard v1 benchmarks (snapshots July 2023 - June 2024), plus a chosen-option tensor for a 600-model ARC subsample. Built to study correlated failure between models at a scale where the model axis, not the item axis, is the large one. Derived from the open-llm-leaderboard-old archive by column-selective parquet reads at zero compute cost.
citeAs: Gupta, S. (2026). How Many Independent Models Does an Open-Model Ecosystem Contain? Evidence at the Exact Conditional Null.

distribution.name: correctness-matrices
distribution.description: One compressed NumPy archive per benchmark. Each holds 'prim' (models x items, 1 = correct), 'models' (HuggingFace repo ids) and 'dates' (leaderboard snapshot date).

recordSet.name: outcomes
recordSet.description: One record per (model, item, benchmark) cell.

field.name: benchmark
field.description: One of arc, winogrande, truthfulqa, gsm8k, hellaswag.

field.name: model_id
field.description: HuggingFace repository id of the evaluated model, from the 'models' array.

field.name: item_index
field.description: Item identity is the ROW INDEX of the benchmark's evaluation file, not a stable upstream identifier -- upstream ids are not consistent across harness schema generations. Verified by src/audit_roworder.py: 149 of 149 readable models in a 150-model sample spanning 2023-07-18 to 2024-05-30 and both identity-column schema generations had byte-identical ordering, zero mismatches. Still a sample of ~1,400 models, not a proof; an undetected misalignment would bias correlation estimates toward zero.

field.name: correct
field.description: 1 if the model answered the item correctly. NOT one quantity across benchmarks: ARC/HellaSwag/Winogrande/TruthfulQA-mc1 correctness is length-normalised log-likelihood ranking over answer continuations; GSM8K is strict-match extraction from generated text. Pooling assumes a comparability that does not strictly hold.

field.name: snapshot_date
field.description: Leaderboard snapshot date for this model's evaluation.

cr:knownLimitations: The population is NOT a sample of independent models. Removing models agreeing with a retained model above 0.95 discards 36-64% of each benchmark's population. A name-based family census attributes only ~35% of model ids to a named base family. Any analysis treating rows as exchangeable is partly measuring duplication.
Item alignment is verified on 149 of a 150-model sample with zero mismatches (see outcomes/item_index), but that remains a sample of ~1,400.
'Correct' is not one quantity across the five benchmarks (see outcomes/correct).
Benchmark contamination is NOT measured, though it produces the same signature these matrices are used to study.
The window July 2023 - June 2024 spans multiple lm-evaluation-harness versions and normalisation conventions; shared scoring artifacts can masquerade as shared model behaviour.
The reconstructed ARC answer key has an undocumented ~1% label-error rate whose downstream effect is unquantified.
Not suitable for claims about currently deployed systems: the population predates Llama-3.1, Qwen-2.5 and reasoning models, and the v1 suite was retired for saturation and contamination.
No DOI, no checksums and no archival mirror yet; deposit on Zenodo is pending.
